title: A Lower Bound on the Self-intersections of Fold Singularities
summary: For an oriented surface $S$, the singular set of a fold map $f:S\rightarrow \mathbb{R}^2$ is a collection of smooth curves, also known as fold singularities. We construct a sharp lower bound on the number of self-intersections of such fold singularities. This is done by first establishing a sharp lower bound on the number of self-intersections of the boundary of a surface immersed in $\mathbb{R}^2$.
